about_short_description.short_description: 10X Genomics ELV solutions and security systems company that provides an innovative genomics platform.

product.name: Chromium Single Cell
product.description: A single-cell multiomics platform for analyzing thousands of samples and billions of cells, including FFPE material, to characterize cell types, subtypes, biomarkers, and gene-regulatory interactions.

product.name: Atera In Situ
product.description: An in situ spatial biology platform providing whole-transcriptome analysis at subcellular resolution and single-cell sensitivity, with throughput of up to 800 1 cm² samples per year.

product.name: Xenium In Situ
product.description: An in situ spatial analysis platform that combines high-resolution imaging with onboard data analysis to measure gene expression and other molecular features within intact tissue.

product.name: Visium Spatial
product.description: A spatial transcriptomics platform for measuring gene expression across tissue sections while preserving spatial context, supported by Visium assays and the Visium CytAssist instrument.

product.name: Flex Apex
product.description: A Chromium Precision workflow for profiling FFPE samples and fixed whole blood to investigate biological factors associated with treatment response or failure.

product.name: Technical Support and Customer Services
product.description: Customer-facing support for product orders, technical questions, frequently asked questions, and workflow assistance, delivered through the 10x Genomics Support Hub and service contacts.
